why: Toll is stale: the story, headline, standfirst and both infographic covers say 10 dead and 15 injured 'by 4:45 pm local time', but a source the story itself lists (Turkiye Today, updated 7:42 pm local) reports President Erdogan putting the toll at 16 dead and 13 injured after the Cabinet meeting. The body also names outlets (the Anadolu news agency, the Evrensel daily) in English and Hindi, breaking rule 14.
